suggestions.label: Shape the CRM for my business
suggestions.prompt: Shape this CRM for how my business works: read crm.config.json and the closest example in examples/, ask me only what you cannot infer from this project, then set the words for a customer, the stages, sources, custom fields, who looks after each customer, the time zone, which forms count as leads and what a job or visit is called and records, make the live stages match, restart the service, and show me in plain words what you set. We are:

suggestions.label: Import the customer list I use today
suggestions.prompt: I keep my customers in a spreadsheet today. I will attach it as a CSV; run node scripts/import.mjs with --dry-run first, show me the column mapping and how many are new, matched or folded together, then import it when I say so.

suggestions.label: Who got in touch this week?
suggestions.prompt: Using node scripts/inbox.mjs --since 7d and node scripts/customers.mjs follow-up, tell me who got in touch this week (and who is not a customer yet), then who I should follow up with and why, one line each.

suggestions.label: Add people from what I tell you
suggestions.prompt: I will describe people in plain words; add each as a customer with node scripts/customers.mjs add (and a note for what happened), picking the stage, tags, owner and fields from what I say, and confirm in a short list. Here they are:

suggestions.label: Publish to production (team only)
suggestions.prompt: Publish the CRM to production with npm run deploy (the crm skill): it applies the schema, builds and deploys to Cloudflare. Open the production address to check it, and tell me who can see it. It stays team only.
